name: Insight Digital Partners II
summary: Insight Digital Partners II operates as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC). Its primary objective is to identify and complete a strategic business combination, which could take various forms such as a merger, a capital stock exchange, an asset acquisition, a stock purchase, or a reorganization, with one or more target enterprises. This entity was established on July 11, 2025, and its operations are based in New York, NY.
